scope.equivalence: Only insignificant trailing fractional-second zeros. Significant digits are retained as strings without Date conversion or numeric rounding. Original UTC suffix is preserved.
scope.runtime: Explicit UTC process environment, resolved timezone and zero offset observed before services; v1 runtime unchanged.
scope.unchanged: Public authenticated sync, exact other logical metadata and proof bytes, owner isolation, pagination, empty replacement, source-off cold read/decrypt/spend, cleanup, four directions and two fresh repetitions.
scope.rawRecords: All original timestamp strings and RPC/report bytes retained.
scope.historical: V1 default remains millisecond-projection behavior; historical source-bound archives are replayed using their exact frozen source.
